description: This file defines an ArxivTool class for searching and retrieving academic papers from Arxiv, including fetching metadata, parsing XML responses, and optionally downloading and extracting full PDF content.

classes.name: ArxivTool
classes.description: A class extending DynamicStructuredTool to search for and retrieve academic papers from Arxiv, with options for summaries or full PDF content extraction.

methods.name: isArxivIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a query string matches the pattern of an Arxiv ID.

methods.name: parseArxivResponse
methods.description: Parses XML response from Arxiv API into a list of ArxivResult objects.

methods.name: extractXmlValue
methods.description: Extracts the value of a specific XML tag from a string.

methods.name: fetchResults
methods.description: Performs a search query to the Arxiv API and returns results.

methods.name: downloadAndExtractPdf
methods.description: Downloads a PDF from Arxiv and extracts its text content.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Main method to perform search and retrieve results, either summaries or full content.
